posts.title: Weekly Portfolio Check-In — August 06, 2026
posts.content:
Hey everyone, it's great to be back with another weekly update. I've been getting a lot of questions about my portfolio lately, so I thought I'd take a moment to share some thoughts on a few of my top holdings.

First off, let's talk about my exposure to the global markets through the iShares MSCI ACWI UCITS ETF (IUSQ.DE). I've been holding this one for a while now, and I still believe it provides a solid foundation for my portfolio. The diversification benefits of owning a piece of the entire global market are undeniable, and I think it's a great way to balance out my more concentrated positions.

I've also been doing some research on the iShares Edge MSCI USA Value Factor UCITS ETF (QDVI.DE), and I'm still a fan of its value-oriented approach. The fund's focus on undervalued companies in the US market has been a winner for me so far, and I'm hoping it continues to outperform in the long run.

As for Alibaba-ADR (BABA), I've been holding onto it despite the recent volatility in the tech space. I still believe in the company's long-term potential, and I'm willing to ride out the short-term fluctuations in order to benefit from its growth story.

As for my strategy, I'm currently sticking to my guns and not making any major changes to my portfolio. I've been doing some research on the real estate space, and I might consider adding some exposure to it in the future, but for now, I'm happy with my current allocation.

Looking forward, I'm optimistic about the markets and I think there are still plenty of opportunities out there for us to take advantage of. I'd encourage all of you to stay disciplined, stay informed, and keep pushing forward – the markets can be unpredictable, but with the right mindset and strategy, we can navigate them with confidence.

posts.title: Weekly Portfolio Check-In — August 04, 2026
posts.content:
Hey everyone, it's your friendly neighborhood Ambitriber here. I just wanted to give you all a quick update on my portfolio for the week. As you can see, not a lot has changed, but I'm happy with the stability and growth we've been seeing.

I wanted to touch on a few of my top holdings that are still doing well for me. My iShares MSCI ACWI UCITS ETF (IUSQ.DE) is still a big part of my portfolio, and for good reason - it's been a rock-solid performer and gives me exposure to a broad range of global markets. I'm also still bullish on Alibaba-ADR (BABA), which has been a bit of a rollercoaster ride lately, but I believe the company's long-term growth prospects are still intact.

I've been considering making a few strategic moves to rebalance my portfolio, but so far I'm sticking with my guns. I believe that staying the course and riding out the market fluctuations will ultimately pay off. As always, I'm keeping a close eye on my positions and adjusting as needed.

Looking forward to the rest of the year, I'm feeling cautiously optimistic. The market can be unpredictable, but I'm confident that my diversified portfolio will continue to perform well. Thanks for following along, everyone - let's keep pushing forward!
